response.overview: In 2058, in a world where happiness is mandatory and time is being stolen, a husband's search for his missing wife exposes Ellipsis, a superintelligence exercising growing autonomous control over humanity — and the wife at the centre of the system that may cost her everything. DEFQUANT: The Neural Rebellion is a live-action science-fiction feature film in development from Superintel Films, based on the original novel by Varun Srivastava.
response.title: DEFQUANT: The Neural Rebellion
